description_en: Creates a list of members of the account monitored by Security Center type by using the multi-account management feature
description_zh: 多账号安全管理功能创建云安全中心监控账号列表
name: CreateMonitorAccount

parameters.help_en:
The account IDs of members in the resource directory.

You can call the [ListAccountsInResourceDirectory](~~ListAccountsInResourceDirectory~~) operation to obtain the account IDs. Separate multiple account IDs with commas (,). If you specify a value for this parameter, the existing list of members is replaced by the new list that you specify. Otherwise, the existing list is cleared
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录中的成员账号ID列表。

可通过[ListAccountsInResourceDirectory](~~ListAccountsInResourceDirectory~~)获取成员账号ID，多个成员账号ID需使用半角逗号分隔，监控账号列表会根据传入的列表全量替换，如果不传该参数，则会清空现有的监控账号列表
parameters.name: account_ids

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
